story_description: Enable users to browse, preview, and apply pre-built hook templates from a curated gallery, reducing friction in hook creation by providing battle-tested patterns for common use cases like security validation, testing gates, and logging.
task_description: Create HookTemplateGalleryView SwiftUI component that displays a searchable, filterable gallery of hook templates organized by category with template cards showing metadata, preview capability, and one-click application to the current hook configuration.
atom_description: Implement HookTemplateGalleryView as a SwiftUI view with category filter chips (All, Security, Testing, Logging, Context, Workflow), search bar with real-time filtering, grid layout of template cards displaying name with emoji icon, description, event type, hook type, and Preview/Use Template action buttons.
problem_statement: Creating hooks from scratch requires users to understand hook event schemas, proper JSON structure, shell scripting patterns, and security best practices. This creates high friction for new users and leads to error-prone configurations. Users need a curated gallery of pre-built, tested hook templates they can browse by category, preview before applying, and apply with a single click. The template gallery should make hook creation accessible to users without deep CLI knowledge while providing enough metadata for informed template selection.

Category filtered state: Specific category chip highlighted, grid shows only matching templates
Search active state: Search bar focused with typed text, grid shows matching templates
Combined filter state: Category selected AND search text present, grid shows intersection
Empty results state: No templates match current filters, empty state message displayed
Preview sheet state: Modal sheet open showing full template configuration
Loading state: Placeholder cards with shimmer animation while templates load (if async)

User taps All chip: Returns to showing all templates, other chip deselects
User types in search bar: Real-time filtering with 100ms debounce, grid updates
User taps search clear button: Search text clears, grid shows all templates for current category
User taps Preview button on card: Opens HookTemplatePreviewSheet modal with template details
User taps Use Template button on card: Calls onSelectTemplate, may dismiss gallery depending on parent
User scrolls grid: Smooth vertical scrolling through template cards
User taps outside preview sheet: Sheet dismisses, returns to gallery

edge_cases: Edge case 1: Zero templates in store - display friendly empty state explaining no templates available, not error
Edge case 2: Very long template name - truncate with ellipsis after 2 lines in card, full name in preview
Edge case 3: Very long template description - truncate with ellipsis after 2 lines in card, full description in preview
Edge case 4: Search text contains special regex characters - escape properly to prevent crash
Edge case 5: Rapid category switching - cancel pending filter operations, only apply latest
Edge case 6: Template store loads asynchronously - show loading placeholders, then animate in cards
Edge case 7: User rotates device or resizes window - grid adapts columns appropriately
Edge case 8: Template has no icon defined - fall back to default gear icon
Edge case 9: Category has zero templates - show category-specific empty state message
Edge case 10: Search returns exactly one result - still display in grid layout for consistency
failure_modes: FM1: HookTemplateStore fails to load - display error state with retry button, log error details
FM2: Template JSON decoding fails - skip malformed template, log warning, display remaining valid templates
FM3: Preview sheet fails to present - log error, show inline alert toast, allow retry
FM4: Memory pressure during large grid render - use LazyVGrid to defer off-screen card rendering
FM5: VoiceOver cannot parse card - ensure all elements have accessibility labels
FM6: Search crashes on certain input - wrap search in do-catch, fallback to showing all templates

risks: Risk 1: Template store may grow large over time, impacting initial load performance
Risk 2: Search algorithm may not scale well with hundreds of templates
Risk 3: Two-column grid may not adapt well to very narrow container widths
Risk 4: Template card height consistency may break with variable content lengths
Risk 5: VoiceOver navigation may be confusing with complex card structure
mitigations: Mitigation 1: Implement lazy loading and consider pagination for large template sets
Mitigation 2: Use indexed search or pre-computed search tokens for large catalogs
Mitigation 3: Implement adaptive column count based on container width
Mitigation 4: Use fixed card height with consistent truncation rules
Mitigation 5: Test with VoiceOver early and iterate on accessibility labels
risk_register.blast_radius: Limited to hook template gallery feature. Failure does not affect core hook execution or other settings views. Users can still create hooks manually without templates.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If gallery has critical bugs, hide template gallery button in hook builder. Users can still create hooks manually. Templates can be provided via documentation as copy-paste configurations until gallery is fixed.
